sv.title: Barnen räddades ur sina dödade mammors kroppar
sv.summary: Ola Younis högsta önskan var att få barn. Hon fick en liten pojke, Malek. Men själv var hon död när han föddes.

en.title: Children rescued from their dead mothers' bodies
en.summary: Ola Younis's greatest wish was to have children. She gave birth to a little boy, Malek. But she was already dead when he was born.
